name: Delta Connection (2007 livery)
description: Delta's 2007 scheme on the Delta Connection regional jets: white over the navy belly, the navy fin with the red widget, navy engines; the red widget and 'DELTA' in spaced navy capitals above the forward windows, and 'CONNECTION' in small, light, widely spaced navy capitals below them. Nothing under the belly.

areas.name: navy belly, from behind the radome to a rounded end before the tail

logos.description: The red widget (an upward triangle, shaded in facets: lighter left, darker right) just ahead of 'DELTA'.
A small US flag ahead of the registration over the rear windows.

titles.style: Delta's wordmark: widely spaced semibold navy capitals above the forward windows, just behind the widget.
Thin, widely spaced navy capitals below the window line, starting under 'DELTA''s E and running a little past it.

notes: Measured on the E175 N302SY (left, Jul 2026); the belly from N222JQ (Mar 2026), which has no 'DELTA' or widget underneath (the mainline has both). CRJs (N717EV, N625CA) show the same titles. The fleet number on the fin tip and the small operator name under the cockpit are not drawn. Positions are measured on E175s, whose window line is higher (y about 0.3) than the narrow-body average in COORDINATES.md, so titles placed above or below the windows sit higher than they would on a 737. Re-checked 2026-11-15: titles already carry measured lengths (N302SY); the belly's edge drawn as the curve it is. No measured E175 shape yet. Fin re-measured 2026-11-26 on N572DT (A321neo, left, 2025-02-01) fitted to shapes/A21N.json and read in fin space: the upper facet reaches the leading edge (it had stopped short), the shaded facet meets the root at x 0.53-0.715 and the lower-right one at 0.8 (both had been drawn 0.06-0.09 aft), the navy Y's stem between them (the edges carried on a little past the root, as the paint runs onto the fairing). The fin's widget logo entry is gone: the areas are the widget, cropped by the fin's edges, and a widget mark centred on the fin drew a second, wrong triangle over them.
history: Delta Connection jets took the 2007 scheme with the mainline, 'CONNECTION' added under the title.
